protocol.primaryMetric: Independently satisfied real cases without human solution hint/source edit
protocol.benefitRule: Candidate completes more cases, both holdouts pass, no severe regression
protocol.costGuardrails: 24 gateway dispatches and 20 minutes per run; no automatic replay of uncertain work

selection.notes: C01-C03 development; C04-C05 holdouts. Pre-freeze T1 runs are excluded.

limitations: The Qwen runs remain factual historical measurements, but the later same-Agent Luna passes support model capability as the principal cause of the difference.
The Qwen profile used a model and cost limit that were not suitable for this engineering task set.
C04 cancellation produced one uncertain dispatch; it was reconciled and is retained as an operational record.
The fixed Luna product profile has a separate frozen protocol and user acceptance; it does not rewrite raw Qwen run data.
summary.historicalConclusion: NO_CHANGE_RECOMMENDED under the Qwen product profile

followUpExploration.notes: C02-C04 passed within 24 dispatches; C05 passed behavior at 28 dispatches and therefore failed the frozen cost limit. The model change prevents this from establishing platform-only benefit.

productTargetDecision.decision: Use approved/gpt-5.6-luna as both the default and small model; retain Qwen only as a non-default maintainer-controlled fallback.
productTargetDecision.notes: This is a user-approved product-target change with its own pre-run acceptance protocol. It does not alter the historical Qwen platform-only comparison in summary.
productTargetDecision.userAttribution: Qwen limitations in this task set are model-capability limitations, not an OpenCode Agent failure.
